nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Computer system to visualize data from an IP rights database," describing a data processing system that visualizes IP rights data as a geographic map with data visualizations.

A computer system (10) that visualizes data from an IP rights database as a geographic map having a viewable area, generating and updating data visualizations based on the current map coordinates and restriction criteria.<SEP>A system having one or more processors and memory configured to evaluate information via a computer network, including receiving user interest indications, determining keyword weights, ranking keywords, and selecting advertisements.<SEP>A computer-based system that detects user interest, identifies keywords, determines keyword weights, receives content requests, ranks keywords, and selects content such as advertisements for display with information resources.

A database containing intellectual property rights records, including geographic addresses of IP right owners, used as the source for generating lists of IP rights.<SEP>A database containing IP rights records, including geographic addresses of IP right owners, from which lists of IP rights are generated and restricted.
A displayed geographic map having a viewable area whose geographic coordinates define the geographic area used to filter IP rights by owner address.

A component (23) that receives and stores geographic coordinates of the viewable area, compares current coordinates with previously stored coordinates, and generates a display change notification when they differ or after a pre-defined time period with no change.

A notification issued upon detecting a change in the viewable area of the geographic map, generated after a pre-defined time period elapses with no change in the viewable area.<SEP>A notification generated by the map display change monitor that includes the geographic coordinates of the current viewable area of the geographic map.

A component (37) that generates a list of IP rights from the IP rights database whose owner's geographic address falls within the current map coordinates, and restricts the list based on restriction criteria to form a restricted list.

A list of IP rights filtered from the IP rights database based on one or more restriction criteria related to the IP rights.<SEP>A list of IP rights filtered to those with an owner address within the current viewable map area and further restricted by one or more restriction criteria.

A component that generates and displays an information pane containing data visualizations derived from the restricted list of IP rights, and generates or updates each data visualization based on geographic co-ordinates of the current viewable area.<SEP>A component (26) that generates and displays an information pane containing data visualizations derived from the restricted list of IP rights, updating them upon each successive display change notification.

A display pane containing one or more data visualizations derived from a restricted list of IP rights.<SEP>A displayed pane containing one or more data visualizations derived from the restricted list of IP rights.

Visual representations generated from the restricted list of IP rights, such as technology type charts, industry type charts, filing trend analysis charts, owner filing size charts, and lists of IP rights owners.<SEP>Visualizations derived from the restricted list of IP rights, such as technology type charts, industry type charts, filing trend analysis charts, and IP rights owner filing size charts.
An interface that ascertains one or more restriction criteria related to the IP rights used to restrict the list of IP rights.

Criteria related to IP rights used to restrict a list of IP rights, including IP jurisdiction, type of IP right, technology type, industry type, filing date, number of applications, owner type, representative listing, IPC classes, and trademark classes.<SEP>Criteria related to IP rights used to restrict the list, including IP jurisdiction, type of IP right, technology type, industry type, filing date, number of applications filed by owner, owner being individual or corporation, representative listing, IPC classes, and trademark classes.
A component that allows the user to select one or more data visualizations based on the restriction criteria.
An interface that displays a geographic map having a viewable area.
A history of use of the system provided by storing geographic coordinates of the viewable area for an entire session or multiple sessions.

An individual or corporation that owns an IP right, whose geographic address is used to determine inclusion in the list of IP rights.<SEP>An owner of an IP right whose geographic address is used to determine whether the IP right falls within the current viewable map area; may be an individual or a corporation.
A display component showing a geographic map with a viewable area defined by geographic co-ordinates, used to determine which IP rights are visualized.
A message generated in relation to a change in the viewable area of the geographic map, generated after a pre-defined time period elapses and there has been no change in the viewable area.
Intellectual property rights, including patents and trademarks, that are listed, restricted, and visualized in the described system and process.
Defined International Patent Classification classes used as a restriction criterion for patent IP rights.
Defined classes used as a restriction criterion for trademark IP rights.
A data visualization chart showing filing trend analysis for the IP rights.

A patent publication titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query derived from a short message.
A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.
A classification of context data determined by the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.
A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

A message content whose meaning the context-data is related to, and to which relevant context data is linked and formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device, whose term meanings are used to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, or forwarded with the short message.

A device that generates a short message and a query; context data may be provided to it, and it may be a smart phone.<SEP>A portable device that includes at least a camera and a screen, runs an application in operative communication with the camera, and displays results by augmenting the source image with indicia. It may be a mobile phone, tablet, PDA, or dedicated camera.<SEP>A portable device including at least a camera and a screen, used to interact with the social networking service; may be a mobile phone, tablet, PDA, or dedicated camera.

A computing device operated by a context-data provider that is used in collecting a set of context-data.<SEP>A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and collects context data from context-data providers.<SEP>A computing system that receives requests, traverses social networks to identify connecting persons, and sends identifications or responses back to the requesting person's computer.<SEP>A server hosted by the computing device that performs the typographical error classification operations.<SEP>A computing system that streams video content features to a client.<SEP>A server that receives data comprising characteristics of e-mail exchanges from the interaction database, assigns weights to characteristics, and transfers data to a processor.<SEP>A system that receives data comprising characteristics of e-mail exchanges, assigns weights to characteristics, and transfers data to a processor for generating relationship data.
A mobile device that receives context data, to which context data may be provided, and which may access a database storing the received context data.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.
A monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.<SEP>A storage system storing keywords, weights, and associations with parked domain web pages having unique identifiers.<SEP>A storage system from which keywords of advertisements are identified using the unique identifier of a parked domain web page, and which stores keyword weights associated with web pages.<SEP>A searchable storage system in which extracted management data is stored in a searchable format.<SEP>A storage repository in which the management data is stored in a searchable format for subsequent review and query by users and administrators.<SEP>A searchable storage system in which management data is stored in a searchable format.<SEP>A searchable database in which the management data is stored in a searchable format.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to the receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to a short message to query the database for the received context data.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the context-data acquisition and ranking method.

An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions to perform context-data acquisition and ranking operations.

The term "Processor" refers to a hardware component or computing unit within a system that executes program instructions stored in memory to carry out a wide range of operations. As a component of a network device, the processor is operative to perform filtering actions. It is also the hardware component on which a recommendation application executes, and it functions as a computing component used to determine relationship proximities, rank recommendations, and generate recommendation lists. In another context, the processor serves as a processing unit used to perform clustering of viewed pages and search keywords and to estimate total and deliverable inventories.

The processor is further configured to execute program instructions to perform operations such as receiving short messages, determining context-data types, ranking sources, and rendering or appending context data. Additionally, it is operable to execute a software program that performs steps including receiving, extracting, and storing management data, and in a related configuration, to execute a software program that causes it to perform steps including receiving a data-stream and extracting management data. More generally, the processor is a component capable of carrying out actions such as receiving, extracting, and storing management data. Across these descriptions, the processor consistently functions as the executing component that drives the various operations of the systems in which it is employed.<SEP>A processor that performs the method steps and executes the program.<SEP>A processor coupled to memory and programmed by program code stored in the memory to implement the modules of the apparatus.<SEP>A component that generates relationship data by determining a relationship strength associated with each pair of users.<SEP>A component that receives data from the server and generates relationship data by determining a relationship strength associated with each pair of users.<SEP>A component in communication with the memory that executes the stored instructions of the diagnosis assistance system.

At least one memory having program instructions executed by the processor.<SEP>A component of the system that bears instructions which, upon execution by a processor, cause the system to perform the described operations.<SEP>A storage component operatively connected to the processor in the recommendation system.<SEP>A storage component operatively connected to the processor in which the recommendation application resides.<SEP>A component of an apparatus that stores data and is operatively coupled to a processing device.<SEP>Memory coupled to the processor that stores program code programming the processor.<SEP>A component of the system that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, returning subsets, and computing costs.

A network through which context data may be communicated to a mobile device; its state may be a specified parameter.<SEP>A network over which queries are received and responses are transmitted electronically; may be the Internet.<SEP>A network over which queries are received electronically and responses are transmitted electronically to the party; the Internet is one such network.<SEP>A network over which queries are received and responses transmitted electronically, which may be the Internet.

An entity with at least one server that supplies a set of context-data and is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a server collects a set of context data related to the meaning of short message content.

A measure used to weight and algorithmically select relevant context data, comprising a monetary cost of the context-data.<SEP>A measure according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A device by which the context-data is obtained.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.

Data elements related to the meaning of a short message content, collected from context-data providers and obtained by a physical sensor, weighted and selected according to at least one metric such as monetary cost.
A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted, comprising a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A cost of the context-data that serves as a metric for selecting relevant context data.

A procedure comprising collecting context-data, algorithmically selecting relevant context data according to a metric, linking the relevant context data to the short message, and formatting them according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A method comprising receiving a data-stream, storing it to a backup storage device, reading it out and extracting management data, and storing the management data in a searchable format in a database.
A physical context of the device that generated the short message, to which the context data is related.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.
A patent (US9514753B2) describing methods, systems, and apparatus for performing speaker identification using hash-based indexing of speaker vectors.

A vector derived from an utterance, for which hash values are determined according to multiple different hash functions and which is compared with speaker vectors to select a speaker vector.<SEP>A vector derived from an utterance, used as the query in speaker identification; may be an i-vector determined via multivariate factor analysis or parameters based on deep neural network activations.
Values determined for an utterance vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to look up speaker vectors in hash tables.

Multiple different functions used to compute hash values for vectors; may include locality sensitive hash functions and hashing based on the position of a vector with respect to different hyperplanes.
Vectors each derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, stored in hash tables and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.
A plurality of tables storing speaker vectors indexed by hash values, from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using the hash values of an utterance vector.

Data indicating the identity of a speaker, determined based on associations between speaker vectors and respective speakers and corresponding to a selected speaker vector.<SEP>The identity of a speaker determined from the selected speaker vector, with data indicating the speaker identity being output.
An utterance vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of the utterance.
A speaker vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of one or more utterances of a respective speaker.
A neural network whose activations, occurring in response to information about an utterance being provided, are used to determine parameters of utterance vectors and speaker vectors.
Media items that include utterances of a speaker corresponding to the selected speaker vector, which may be identified and indicated in output data.
A type of hash function used to determine hash values for utterance vectors.
Geometric constructs with respect to which the position of an utterance vector is used to determine hash values.
Scores each indicating a degree of similarity between the utterance vector and one of the speaker vectors in the set, used to select the most similar speaker vector.
A measure of distance between the utterance vector and each speaker vector in the set, used to determine similarity scores.
A threshold value against which the smallest cosine distance is compared to decide whether to select the corresponding speaker vector.
Authenticating a particular user based at least in part on determining that the selected speaker vector corresponds to that particular user.
A set of multiple video resources accessed to generate a speaker vector for each resource.

A person whose speech is characterized by speaker vectors derived from one or more of the speaker's utterances.<SEP>A person whose speech characteristics are represented by speaker vectors and whose identity is determined from an utterance.

The term "User" refers to an individual interacting with various systems and interfaces across multiple contexts. In one context, a user is a particular person to whom a selected speaker vector may correspond and who may be authenticated based on that correspondence. In another context, users are individuals who previously submitted search keywords and viewed pages, with their history forming the basis for estimating inventory. A user may also be an individual who provides feedback on a work, including decisions on whether potential typographical errors are author-intended strings.

In the context of messaging systems, a user is a person enabled to move an identified message to another message folder and able to select execution of a multi-pass message filter through an interface on the client device. Similarly, a user is a person for whom messages are sorted into folders and who is presented with misclassification information in order to move messages.

In the context of content recommendation and video content, a user is a person associated with a client who interacts with video content features and expresses preferences toward characters, receiving content recommendations. Likewise, a user is a person who interacts with network content, expresses preferences toward characters, and for whom recommendations may be generated. Additionally, a user is a person who provides explicit feedback favoring the first fictional character and whose preferences contribute to the relationship score.<SEP>Users and administrators of the original data who review and query the management data stored in the database.<SEP>An individual for whom user relationships are established and to whom filtered digital media content is presented with priority based on relevancy weights.<SEP>A user who has relationships with content producers, has a user profile, and to whom digital media content is presented.
A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, used to characterize the speech of that speaker and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.
A data structure from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using hash values, with a different speaker vector determined for each of multiple hash tables.
A value determined for an utterance vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to determine speaker vectors from a plurality of hash tables.
One of multiple different functions used to determine hash values for an utterance vector.
A spoken input from which an utterance vector is derived and which is associated with a respective speaker.
A video resource in a set of multiple video resources, for which a speaker vector is generated.

A device storing instructions that, when executed by one or more computers, cause the computers to perform operations for speaker identification.<SEP>A storage device with an executable program stored thereon that instructs a processor to perform the filtration method.<SEP>A storage device storing an executable program for presenting digital media content, establishing user relationships, and determining relevancy weights, as described in the claims.
One or more computers that execute instructions stored on a computer-readable storage device to perform operations.
A technique used to determine parameters of utterance i-vectors and speaker i-vectors.

A patent titled "Systems and methods for selecting content using weighted terms" describing techniques for evaluating information via a computer network using weighted keywords to select content for display.

A web page with a unique identifier that lacks content having keywords other than content provided via the data processing system, and on which advertisements are displayed.<SEP>A web page with a unique identifier that lacks content having keywords other than content provided via the data processing system, used to display advertisements and receive content selections.<SEP>A web page displayed on a parked domain that hosts advertisements and keywords, with keyword weights specific to the page.

A term associated with an advertisement displayed on a parked domain web page, having a weight determined based on user interest and historic performance, and used to select advertisements for display.<SEP>A term associated with subject matter of an information resource or advertisement, assigned a weight used to rank and select content for display.<SEP>A term associated with advertisements on the parked domain web page, having weights that may differ across information resources.<SEP>Keywords of the data files of the data-stream, obtained by indexing types of data, included in the management data.

A value assigned to a keyword for a parked domain web page, determined based on user interest indications and historic performance, and used to rank keywords.<SEP>A value determined for each keyword of an information resource based on user interest indications and historic performance, used to rank keywords and select content.<SEP>A value assigned to each of a plurality of characteristics for each pair of users, used to determine relationship strength.

An advertisement displayed with a parked domain web page, associated with one or more keywords and selected for display based on keyword weights and rankings.<SEP>Promotional content displayed on a parked domain web page, associated with keywords and selected for display based on ranked keyword weights.

An indication of a user's interest in an advertisement, including at least one of a click, a selection, a finger gesture, a mouse over, and a conversion.<SEP>A signal of a user's interest in an advertisement, including at least one of a click, a selection, a finger gesture, a mouse over, and a conversion.<SEP>An indication of a user's interest in an advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page.
A form of user interest indication representing a user's selection of an advertisement.
A form of user interest indication representing a completed desired action by a user.

An identifier associated with a parked domain web page, used to identify keywords and advertisements corresponding to the page.<SEP>An identifier of a parked domain web page used to identify keywords of advertisements from a database.

Past performance on the parked domain web page of keywords corresponding to user interest of users other than the first user, used in determining keyword weights.<SEP>Past performance data of keywords on a parked domain web page corresponding to user interest of users, used in determining keyword weights.

A user whose indication of interest in a first advertisement displayed on a parked domain web page is received.<SEP>A user whose indication of interest in a first advertisement displayed on a parked domain web page is received by the data processing system.<SEP>A user referenced in the context of the parked domain web page.<SEP>The user seeking assistance in finding a second user via a social network; has an associated identifier, a location, and a social network that may be traversed and combined from multiple social network types.

A user whose indication of interest in a second advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page is received.<SEP>A user whose indication of interest in a second advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page is received by the data processing system.<SEP>A user whose indication of interest in the second advertisement is received.<SEP>The user being sought by the first user; has an associated identifier and a possible location determined through the social network.

A user different from the first user and the second user, for whom a request for content to provide for display with the parked domain web page is received.<SEP>A user different from the first and second users who requests content to provide for display with the parked domain web page.<SEP>A user in the first user's social network who is likely to connect the first user's social network with the third user's own social network and whose last-known location is within a predetermined distance of the first user's location; may opt in to sharing identity, social network, or location information.

An advertisement displayed with the parked domain web page, associated with the first keyword and corresponding to the first keyword.<SEP>An advertisement displayed on a parked domain web page in which the first user indicates interest, associated with a plurality of keywords including a first keyword.<SEP>An advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page.

An advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page, associated with the second keyword.<SEP>An advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page in which the second user indicates interest, associated with a second keyword of the plurality of keywords.<SEP>An advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page, associated with the second keyword and of interest to the second user.

An advertisement selected to provide for display with the parked domain web page based at least in part on the first keyword selected as the highest ranked keyword, different from the first advertisement and the second advertisement.<SEP>An advertisement selected for display with the parked domain web page based on the first keyword ranked highest, different from the first and second advertisements.<SEP>An advertisement selected for display with the parked domain web page based on the first keyword being the highest ranked keyword, different from the first and second advertisements.

A keyword of the plurality of keywords having a first weight on the parked domain web page and a different weight on a second information resource, selectable as the highest ranked keyword.<SEP>A keyword of the plurality of keywords having a first weight on the parked domain web page and a different weight on a second information resource, ranked highest and used to select the third advertisement.<SEP>A keyword with a first weight on the parked domain web page and a different weight on a second information resource.

A keyword of the plurality of keywords associated with a second advertisement, having a second weight determined based on the second user's indication of interest.<SEP>A keyword of the plurality of keywords associated with the second advertisement, having a second weight determined based on the second user's interest indication.<SEP>A keyword associated with a second advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page, whose weight is determined based on user interest.

A keyword of the plurality of keywords associated with a third advertisement, having a third weight determined based on user interest.<SEP>A keyword of the plurality of keywords associated with the third advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page.

An advertisement of the parked domain web page associated with the third keyword, for which an indication of user interest is received.<SEP>An advertisement displayed on the parked domain web page associated with the first keyword, in which a user interest indication is received.
An information resource on which the first keyword has a different weight than on the parked domain web page.

An attribute associated with user interest used in determining keyword weights, including at least one of a temporal characteristic, a day characteristic, a web page content slot characteristic, a monetary characteristic, and a performance characteristic.<SEP>A property of e-mail exchanges between pairs of users, such as interaction frequency, interaction type, number of communication participants, time between interactions, time since a first interaction, time since a last interaction, interaction volume, and ratio of source to target versus target to source interactions.
Interactions of users with advertisements previously displayed on a parked domain web page, used to assign weights to keywords based on the number of interactions.

A network via which information is evaluated by the system.<SEP>A network via which the data processing system receives indications of user interest and requests for content.<SEP>A network over which requests, event data, and recommendations are transmitted between the content site, the personalization network service, and external recommenders.
A method of evaluating information via a computer network comprising receiving user interest indications, identifying keywords, determining weights, ranking keywords, and selecting advertisements.
A threshold that a weight of the highest weighted keyword must satisfy when selecting the highest weighted keyword.

A medium having instructions to evaluate information, comprising instructions to receive user interest indications, identify keywords, determine weights, and select advertisements.<SEP>A computer readable medium storing instructions implementing the described method.<SEP>A medium containing executable instructions that when executed perform a method of generating relationship data.<SEP>A medium containing executable instructions that when executed perform a method of modeling relationships between a plurality of e-mail users.
The weight value of the first keyword on the parked domain web page.
The weight of the second keyword determined based on the indication of user interest of the second user in the second advertisement.
A request from the third user for content to provide for display with the parked domain web page.

A patent document titled "Finding people using social networks" that describes embodiments for assisting a first person in finding a second person using a social network, including systems, methods, and privacy mechanisms.
A person who sends a request to a server identifying himself or herself, the person being sought, and the requestor's location, in order to find a target person using a social network.
The second person whom the requesting person is trying to find through the social network.

A person in the social network of the requesting person who is likely to connect the requesting person's social network with the target person's social network, and who has a last-known location within a predetermined distance from the requesting person's location.

A network of users associated with the first user, determined based on identifiers and possibly combined from different types of social networks, and traversed using origins to find connecting users.<SEP>A network of relationships among people, comprising information from at least one social network service, used to connect a requesting person with a target person.
A service that provides social network information used to determine a person's social network.

The number of degrees of separation between users, such as the first and third users, associated with a type of relationship.<SEP>A measure of the number of intermediary connections between two people in a social network, used to determine the type of relationship between the requesting person and connecting person.

A user's choice to share information about his or her identity, social network, or location with users of at least as many degrees of separation as the number of degrees of separation for the type of relationship.<SEP>A privacy mechanism whereby a connecting person consents to sharing information about his or her identity, social network, or location with people of at least as many degrees of separation as the number of degrees of separation for the type of relationship.
Techniques disclosed in the patent for protecting user information, including anonymizing identifying information and encrypting communications.
A privacy mechanism that removes or obscures identifying information about users.
A privacy mechanism that encrypts communications between parties to protect user information.

The most recent location associated with a connecting person, determined based on a wireless network, a geolocation provided by the person's computer, a venue, or an event the person identified himself or herself as being at.
A threshold distance from the requesting person's location within which a connecting person's last-known location must fall.
A network to which a connecting person's computer is connected, used to determine the last-known location of the connecting person.
Location information provided by a connecting person's computer, used to determine the last-known location.

A place that a user has identified himself or herself as being at, which may be the same as another user's location.<SEP>A place that a connecting person has identified himself or herself as being at, used to determine the last-known location.

An occurrence that a user has identified himself or herself as being at, which may be the same as another user's location.<SEP>An occurrence that a connecting person has identified himself or herself as being at, used to determine the last-known location.<SEP>A condition registered for monitoring with regard to a history object, triggered when stored information describing ETL process performance satisfies specified criteria, and subscribed to by ETL processes or other subscribers.<SEP>An occurrence registered for monitoring with regard to a history object, triggered when the performance of an ETL process satisfies criteria, causing a subscribed ETL process to be performed.

An additional person in the social network of the requesting person who is likely to connect the requesting person's social network with the target person's social network, whose response may be combined with or prioritized against the connecting person's response.
A unified format to which responses from multiple connecting persons' computers are converted before being combined.

A user who may connect the first and third users with at least two degrees of separation, and whose identifier or response may be withheld based on negative affinity or an outdated last-known location.
A location of a user, such as the first user's geographic location, used to determine proximity of other users.
A device having a pre-determined location at which the identifier associated with the first user may be received.
A storage medium bearing computer-executable instructions that, when executed, cause a computer to perform operations for assisting a first user in finding a second user using a social network.

A replacement for an identifier associated with the second user used to anonymize results.<SEP>An element of the series of tokens making up the input query, to which labels are assigned.<SEP>A segment of a given query in the first language containing one or more terms from the given query, used for annotation and translation ordering.
A relationship condition between the first user and a fourth user that causes a determination not to return the fourth user's identifier.
Replacing an identifier associated with the second user with a token and encrypting the anonymized results.
Trimming the social network while traversing, based on a location of people in the social network of the first user.
Walking the social network of the first user using the first user as a first origin and the second user as a second origin.
A patent (US8095432B1) describing a method and system for generating ranked recommendation lists for items based on relationship proximity between members of a social networking utility.

A social network platform in which members have relationships such as friends, non-friends, and group members, and within which items can be searched and recommendations shared.<SEP>A social network platform within which members are friends or non-friends of an inquiring member, and within which items can be searched and recommendations obtained.

A member of the social networking utility who requests searches for items and receives ranked recommendation lists based on relationship proximity to other members.<SEP>A member of the social networking utility who requests a search for an item, receives a recommendation list, and has friends and non-friends within the utility.

A member of the social networking utility who is a friend of the inquiring member and provides a first recommendation for an item.<SEP>A member of the social networking utility who is a friend of the inquiring member and who provides a first recommendation for the item; the first member shares a plurality of interests in common with the inquiring member.

A member of the social networking utility who is a non-friend of the inquiring member and provides a second recommendation for an item.<SEP>A member of the social networking utility who is a non-friend of the inquiring member and who provides a second recommendation for the item.

A member of the social networking utility who has different interests than the inquiring member and provides a third recommendation for an item.<SEP>A member of the social networking utility who has a plurality of different interests than the inquiring member and who provides a third recommendation for the item.

An opinion or endorsement of an item provided by a member of the social networking utility, which is ranked and displayed to an inquiring member.<SEP>A recommendation generated for another user for presentation of content such as the second network content, based on the relationship score and character preferences.

An ordered list of recommendations for an item, ranked according to relationship proximity between recommending members and the inquiring member.<SEP>A ranked list generated for the item comprising the first recommendation and the second recommendation, with the first recommendation placed higher than the second recommendation based on the first rank exceeding the second rank.
A measure of closeness between members within the social networking utility, closest for friends and farthest for strangers, used to rank recommendations.

A product or object for which recommendations are obtained, searched, ranked, and potentially purchased within the social networking utility.<SEP>A product or object for which recommendations are obtained, which can be searched within the social networking utility, and which can be purchased.

A software application executing on the processor and resident in memory, configured to obtain recommendations, rank them, and generate recommendation lists.<SEP>A software application executing on a processor and resident in memory, configured to obtain recommendations for an item from members of a social networking utility, determine relationship proximities, rank recommendations, perform searches, and generate a recommendation list.
A system from which inventory details associated with an item are received and associated with recommendations.
A group associated with an item to which the inquiring member can be added.
A feed of the inquiring member that can be updated to include price information such as a reduced price for an item.
Tags generated for an item and associated with the item to enable searching.
Information associated with an item, received from an inventory management system and associated with recommendations.

A transaction performed for an item after receiving a request to purchase the item from the inquiring member.<SEP>A transaction performed for the item in response to a received request to purchase the item.
